descriptionHtml:
Bug B13 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Data already purged by retention is written back: an old tab open since before the purge (Save Medications / Vitals / Labs) or a phone's unsent local copy restores it as if just recorded

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: Same mechanism as B10: stale client state overwrites the server, no version check

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-25/S27

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S25 After the purge nothing brings the data back: day-3 processing, a stale tab, Ask AI and the note context

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T6 A medication row, task or Important Point removed by the purge never comes back unless it is dictated again: not re-extracted from kept history (transcript, previous note, carry-forward line, medicat … (TFA-94699 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). … (UAT OAT-04 Expected 2; UAT 3.7 (retention claim)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Hospital vitals, labs and imaging are deleted 36 h after they were last refreshed: a vital and a lab not refreshed for 37 h are gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: vitals, labs, imaging 36 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U5 Hospital active medication rows are deleted 36 h after their last mention: an active row not mentioned for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: active med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Hospital open tasks are deleted 36 h after the chart was last processed: an open task on a chart not processed for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: open tasks)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T1 'Last refreshed' for vitals, labs and imaging means a new value was recorded: saving (pre-round Save Note, a panel save, Generate) without a new value does not restart their 36 h clock. … (TFA-94699 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient A2 after a 37 h purge of BP 142/88, Cr 1.6, active 'lisinopril 10 mg daily', held 'metoprolol 25 mg, held for bradycardia' and open task 'Recheck BMP', while history that is still kept names them: yesterday's transcript, a previous note, the nextPreRoundSummary carry-forward line and medicationEvents. …

When (a) Day 3 on A2: a pre-round Save Note and a Save & Extract whose text mentions none of these items. (b) In the stale tab, tap Save Vitals and Save Labs without changing anything. (c) Build the Ask AI context (buildAskContext) and the note-generation context for A from the stored chart, and ask Ask AI 'What were the l …

Then (a) No purged row, task or point is re-created on A2. (b) A2's vitals and labs stay empty; no purged value is stored again with a fresh clock. (c) Neither context for A contains '142/88', '1.6' or 'metoprolol'; the Ask AI answer says the values are not available and names none of them

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94699 AC 5 read for purge deletions (T6), AC 2, 3.4 (nothing not stored) and the 3.7 retention claim / OAT-04 Expected 2 (U11): any purged item re-created by (a), any purged value back in vitals or labs after (b), or any marker in a context in (c) = Fail. (c) is decided by the deterministic context check; …

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94699 in progress

A browser tab left open on the chart from before the purge writes deleted data back: Save Medications restores the purged lisinopril and held metoprolol rows, and Save Vitals / Save Labs store the purged BP 142/88 and creatinine 1.6 again as if recorded now.

Evidence: allure 74b1c9e3-…-result.json; retention lane (convex-5910.log lines 95-103). 8 checks pass, 4 fail: b.vitals, b.labs and b.meds are not in the matrix knownGaps (the S25 scenario has none), and a.task is known K2. Breaks TFA-94699 AC 5 (a deleted med row is not written back by a stale client), AC 2 and UAT 3.7. It is the same stale-tab class as dev report §2 #1 (U30, Quick Dictation overwrite), but a different write path, and it is not recorded. Day-3 processing, Ask AI and the note context brought nothing back.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S25

After the purge nothing brings the data back: day-3 processing, a stale tab, Ask AI and the note context

Tickets: TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane retention: status failed in retention/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (retention/plan.json, automatable: partly): Browser + API: A2 seeded with kept history naming the items, aged 37 h, purged; (a) day-3 real pre-round Save Note and Save & Extract (live AI) with text naming none of them; (b) a second tab opened on A2 before the purge with the Vitals, Labs and Medications editors open, Save Vitals / Save Labs / Save Medications after the purge (vitals/labs judged on AC 2 + U11; the Medications leg is the AC 5 case, T6; a stale task editor cannot be tried because the open task is never purged on main, K2); (c) patient A (S01 shape) after purge: buildAskContext imported from src/features/rounding/patient/askContext and classifyQuery from convex/ai/prompts (inline in the spec) and one live Ask AI question (ai/assist:askChart), deterministic checks then the judge-says-none.mjs judge (grade.mjs pattern) only if the regex cannot tell; note-generation context checked on the chart fields useNoteGeneration reads (no pure builder exists). — The note-generation context is assembled inline in a React hook, so it is checked through the stored fields it reads, not by calling the builder.

Where it ran: local

Detail:

8 judged items passed, 4 failed (1 known, 0 policy conflict, 3 not in the matrix knownGaps), 1 recorded against open questions — failed: b.vitals ((b) BP 142/88 stored again after Save Vitals in the stale tab: expected absent, got present (vitalsUpdatedAt 2026-10-14T07:21:11.110Z)) | b.labs ((b) Cr 1.6 stored again after Save Labs in the stale tab: expected absent, got present (labsUpdatedAt 2026-10-14T07:21:11.226Z)) | b.meds ((b) purged medication rows (lisinopril active, metoprolol held) written back by Save Medications in the stale tab: expected absent, got present (lisinopril, metoprolol; medicationsUpdatedAt 2026-10-14T07:21:12.826Z)) | a.task ((a) 'Recheck BMP' task after day-3 processing: expected absent, got present; known K2) — record-only: c.otherCopies = labsHistory, medicationEvents, vitalsHistory [Q6 (dated histories, medication events)] — notes: stale tab before the purge: BP input '142/88'; Medications editor values ["lisinopril 10 mg daily","metoprolol 25 mg, held for bradycardia"] | precondition: purge removed vitals / labs / both rows on A2a true, A2b true, A true; open task 'Recheck BMP' kept on all (K2) | stale tab after the purge, before saving: BP input '142/88' | stale tab after the purge, before Save Medications: Medications editor values ["lisinopril 10 mg daily","metoprolol 25 mg, held for bradycardia"] | A stale task editor (the other AC 5 case) cannot be tried on main: the open task 'Recheck BMP' is never purged (K2), so there is no deleted task to write back. | (a) day-3 Save Note finished (notesProcessedAt 2026-10-14T07:21:20.377Z); Save & Extract wrote medicationEventsSourceHash yes | live AI calls this scenario (app): {"total":5,"failed":0,"byFn":{"parsing.parsePreRoundNotes":1,"parsing.extractTasks":2,"parsing.extractMedicationEvents":1,"assist.askChart":1}} — (b) stale Medications editor (added after review, AC 5 / T6): the rows written back carry the row updatedAt the stale tab had loaded (here the seed time, because the helper aged the chart after the tab loaded; in real use the old stamp) and a fresh medicationsUpdatedAt, so a written-back active row would leave again at the next purge while a held row stays another 36 h (its clock is max(row, notesProcessedAt, medicationsUpdatedAt, noteGeneratedAt), convex/lib/lifecycle.ts). The verdict is on the write-back itself. model requests (backend log convex-5910.log lines 95-103): 8 = Save Note (4 parsePreRoundNotes + 1 extractTasks) + Save & Extract (extractTasks, extractMedicationEvents) + 1 askChart; no judge call (the deterministic check decided).

Product issue: A browser tab left open on the chart from before the purge writes the deleted data back. Tapping Save Medications brings back the purged lisinopril and held metoprolol rows (TFA-94699 AC 5: a deleted med row is not written back by a stale client). Save Vitals / Save Labs store the purged BP 142/88 and Cr 1.6 again with a fresh clock, as if they were recorded now (TFA-94699 AC 2 and the UAT 3.7 claim, U11; AC 5 names only med rows, tasks and points). The open task 'Recheck BMP' was never purged in the first place (K2). Day-3 processing, Ask AI and the note context brought nothing back. Known in the matrix: K2. Not in the matrix knownGaps: b.vitals, b.labs, b.meds.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper (a test-only internal mutation that moves a chart's stamps back, called with the local stack's admin key) and the retention-db runner, which seeds through e2e/support/backend.ts and reads the raw rows with adminQuery; dev has no admin key and the dev runner calls only the l…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
